title: Ordinary tensor coefficient maps commute with the concrete cone boundary
statement: For commutative rings A,C and a ring homomorphism rho:A to C, let F be termwise scalar extension. Let Q be any A-cochain complex, N any C-cochain complex and t:F(Q) to N a chain map. For f:P1 to P2 of arbitrary A-cochain complexes let P3 be its mapping cone and H the fixed-second-factor total tensor functor with Q. Put a(V)=mu_F(V,Q)^(-1) followed by F(V) tensor t. Then the boundary of F(H(coneTriangle(f))) followed by H^(i+1)(a(P1)) equals H^i(a(P3)) followed by the boundary of tensorConeTriangle(rho,f,N) [lem-pc-tensor-cone-five-term-exact], for every integer i. No derived model, exactness, flatness, or K-flatness hypothesis occurs.

proof.text: Apply the upstream instance HomologicalComplex.commShift_mapBifunctorComparisonNatTrans_flipApp to the oplax scalar-extension tensorator. Compose with the shift-compatible natural transformation induced by t. Its components are precisely a(V). Its naturality and NatTrans.shift_app_comm provide a morphism between the two concrete triangles. Functor.homologySequenceδ_naturality gives the boundary equation; unfold homologySequenceδ and shiftMap to identify homologyδOfTriangle. This first-variable shift identification has no additional homogeneous sign.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorCoefficient_cone_boundary
    (A C : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing C] (ρ : A →+* C)
    (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (N : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} C) ℤ)
    (t : ((extendScalars ρ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q ⟶ N)
    (P₁ P₂ : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (f : P₁ ⟶ P₂) (i : ℤ) :
    let F := (extendScalars ρ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let H := (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} A)).map₂CochainComplex.flip.obj Q
    let T := F.mapTriangle.obj (H.mapTriangle.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone.triangle f))
    let a := fun V ↦ (Functor.Monoidal.μIso F V Q).inv ≫ (F.obj V ◁ t)
    CochainComplex.homologyδOfTriangle T i (i + 1) ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (a P₁) (i + 1) =
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (a (CochainComplex.mappingCone f)) i ≫
        CochainComplex.homologyδOfTriangle (tensorConeTriangle ρ f N) i (i + 1)
